# SD13-E3-F6 deterministic Human Ranger level 1 hybrid chassis baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Ranger level 1 chassis as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat) and stays a single-class, level-1-only hybrid baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later hybrid burden surface: no spell selections, no
# spells known/prepared posture, no combat-style selection, no favored-terrain breadth,
# no animal companion, no tracking-engine accounting. The SD13-E5 favored-enemy slice
# adds the canonical level-1 favored-enemy choice as chosen input only (the selection
# names the chosen enemy type; no target-type matching or conditional application is
# resolved here). It adds only the minimum feat, equipment, choice, and selected-skill
# posture needed to make the bounded level-1 hybrid chassis legible; the remaining
# ranger class-feature and later spell burdens are intentionally left for the runtime
# and matrix to name as still blocking.

source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:ranger:1
ability=strength:16

ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1

choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
